items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Sometimes he had Georgia Boy with him, you know. Different fellas he'd had with him on clarinet.

ctx.x: Punch said he used to play some of the Georgia Boy. Georgia Boy. Did you see in the band?
Georgia Boy? Yeah. Sometime he'd have Georgia Boy. Sometime he'd have Georgia Boy with him.
Where did you all play in those days?
